The beach steps: iron stairs from the boardwalk down to the sand under the pier (a way in and out)
The lifeboat ramp: a slipway from the pier head down into the sea (a way in and out)
The ferry landing at the pier head (a way in and out)
The gates and the arcade: bright lights, slot machines and a candyfloss stall at the landward end
The boardwalk: planks over the water, benches, and people fishing off the rail
The halfway café: closed for the evening, with a long glass front
The pier head: the widest part, with a bandstand and coin telescopes
Finn stands at the bottom of the lifeboat ramp, knee-deep in the sea, singing. The choir stands round him in the water, holding his hands
